description: chat-server/backend.rs and mail-server/backend.rs each define their own SetError struct and SetErrorType enum with identical base variants (Forbidden, OverQuota, TooLarge, RateLimit, NotFound, InvalidPatch, WillDestroy, InvalidProperties, Singleton, AlreadyExists). mail-server/backend.rs adds mail-specific variants on top. When a new base variant is needed (e.g. a future JMAP extension), it must be added to both files separately and both Display impls must be updated. A bug fixed in one SetError (e.g. a missing Display arm) will not be fixed in the other. The base type should live in jmap-server or jmap-types and be extended by domain crates.
title: SetError/SetErrorType duplicated in chat-server and mail-server
